full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic close-up shows a young woman's face against a very dark, plain background. Her head fills nearly the whole frame, with the top of the hair cropped and the upper shoulders entering at the bottom. The face turns only slightly to her left, and both dark eyes look toward the camera from beneath fine brows. Her expression is steady and unsmiling, with relaxed closed lips and no theatrical gesture. Dark hair is drawn back from the forehead, though loose strands remain visible near the right edge. One ear appears faintly at the left side of the head before sinking into shadow. The visible garment has a soft folded collar and textured fabric at the lower right; little else of the clothing is shown. The face is rendered in a continuous range of grays. A pale forehead and cheek receive gentle light, while the side nearest the left edge and the space under the jaw move into deeper tones. The nose casts a subtle shadow across the middle of the face without dividing it into stark black-and-white halves. Fine skin texture and photographic grain remain visible in the middle tones, especially across the cheek and around the eyes. The background offers no objects or patterns, allowing the direct gaze and minute shifts in tone to carry the image. The crop is close enough to emphasize the spacing of the eyes, the line of the mouth, and the quiet contour of the jaw, but it retains enough shoulder to feel like a human presence rather than an isolated detail. Soft natural-looking light arrives from the upper right of the frame, giving the face a sculptural but unforced shape. No lettering appears. The overall composition is calm and direct, using plain darkness, restrained tonal modeling, and an attentive gaze to make an intimate photographic portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白摄影特写：一位年轻女子的脸位于极深、素净的背景前。头部几乎填满画框，发顶被截断，肩膀上部从下边缘进入。脸只略向自身左侧转动，两只深色眼睛在细眉下望向相机。她没有微笑，表情稳定，嘴唇放松闭合，没有戏剧化动作。深发从额头向后梳，但右边缘附近仍可见松散发束。头的左侧隐约露出一只耳朵，随后没入阴影。下方右侧可见带柔软折叠领口和织物肌理的衣服，其他服饰基本不在画内。面容由连续灰阶呈现。浅色额头和脸颊接住柔光，靠左边缘的一侧以及下颌下方转为更深色调。鼻子在脸中央投下微妙阴影，却没有把脸生硬地分成黑白两半。中间调仍可见细微皮肤质地和摄影颗粒，尤其在脸颊和眼睛周围。背景没有物件或花纹，因此直接的目光与细小明暗变化承担整个画面。裁切足够贴近，强调双眼间距、唇线和安静的下颌轮廓，同时仍保留一点肩膀，使画面有完整的人物存在感，而不是孤立细节。自然感的柔光从画面右上进入，让脸显出雕塑般却不刻意的形态。画中没有字迹。整体构图平静而直接，以素净暗处、克制的明暗塑形和专注目光形成亲密的摄影肖像。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography uses a close, level view, plain dark surroundings, and a continuous range of soft grays. The focal area retains fine surface grain and small tonal distinctions rather than glossy smoothness or abrupt posterized contrast. Light falls gently from one side and slightly above, revealing rounded form while allowing peripheral edges to merge gradually with shadow. The background remains unobtrusive, and the framing leaves little distracting negative detail. Clear central features and modest fabric texture provide just enough variation to balance the large dark fields. The overall visual character is direct, patient, and intimate, with subtle tonal observation taking precedence over dramatic effects.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影采用近距离平视、素净深色环境和连续柔灰阶。焦点区域保留细微表面颗粒与小幅明度差，而非光亮平滑或骤然分层的海报式反差。光从一侧略偏上方轻柔落下，显出圆润形态，同时让外围边缘逐渐融入阴影。背景不抢眼，画框里几乎没有分散注意力的空白细节。清楚的中央特征和低调织物肌理提供恰当变化，平衡大片深色。整体视觉气质直接、耐心而亲密，细腻明暗观察优先于戏剧性效果。
theme_en: A direct black-and-white close portrait of a young woman
theme_zh: 年轻女子直视镜头的黑白近景肖像
name: Paul Strand
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
